goal: Empirically evaluate AI representation stack (LIN + math-lang + AINL) vs direct general-purpose LLM generation (Python, standalone LIN, standalone AINL) under independent oracles.

conditions.label: LLM → Python
conditions.description: Direct standard Python generation using canonical scientific stack (numpy/math)

conditions.label: LLM → LIN
conditions.description: LIN semantic IR with strict effects and multi-target compilation

conditions.label: LLM → AINL
conditions.description: AINL workflow DAG orchestrator with structured task execution

conditions.label: LLM → LIN + math-lang + AINL
conditions.description: Composite stack: LIN (micro semantic contract) + math-lang (kernel) + AINL (macro workflow DAG)

cases.title: Multiple Linear Regression (OLS)
cases.contract: Compute exact beta coefficients via OLS normal equations / QR decomposition on fixed dataset D_lin

cases.title: Binary Logistic Regression
cases.contract: Train binary logistic classifier with sigmoid cross-entropy loss to reach log-loss convergence

cases.title: Conjugate Bayesian Inference (Beta-Binomial)
cases.contract: Compute analytical posterior distribution parameters (alpha_post, beta_post) and posterior mean for coin flips under Beta prior

cases.title: Monte Carlo Integration & Pi Estimation
cases.contract: Simulate N=1,000,000 trials with fixed deterministic seed, computing mean estimate and standard error sigma/sqrt(N)

cases.title: Convex Optimization (Gradient Descent)
cases.contract: Minimize Rosenbrock/quadratic bowl within K=500 iterations to reach tolerance epsilon < 1e-6

cases.title: Linear System Solver (Ax = b)
cases.contract: Solve 4x4 non-singular linear system Ax = b, returning solution vector x with residual ||Ax - b|| < 1e-12

cases.title: Micro MLP (2-Layer Feedforward + Backprop)
cases.contract: Train 2-4-1 MLP on non-linear XOR / half-moon dataset with backpropagation; verify strictly decaying loss, gradient norm and final accuracy

cases.title: Non-Linear Curve Fitting (Exponential Decay)
cases.contract: Fit y = a * exp(-b * t) + c to noisy observations using damped least squares, verifying reduced chi-squared and parameter recovery
